_comment: Copy to gestures.json and edit. This file is the security boundary for
hermes_gesture.py: anyone standing in front of the Pi's camera can
trigger everything listed here, so keep it to things you would be
relaxed about a stranger doing.
Keys are matched as '<HAND> <GESTURE>' first, then '<GESTURE>' alone.
Hands are LEFT / RIGHT / ? (unlabelled).
Gestures are FIST OPEN POINT PEACE THUMB CALL ROCK PINCH -- and that
list is CLOSED. Any other hand shape fires nothing at all, which is why
moving your hand around no longer triggers a run of commands.
Action types:
"ctrl+shift+m"                      shorthand for a key action
{"type":"key",  "keys":"volume_up"}
{"type":"url",  "url":"https://youtube.com"}   opens in your browser
{"type":"text", "text":"hello"}     types into the FOCUSED window
{"type":"log"}                       prints only -- audition a gesture
{"type":"run",  "command":["notepad.exe"]}   needs allow_run: true
HERMES <NAME> bindings are for things Hermes asks for by voice or Discord
("open gmail"). The Pi only sends the NAME -- this file decides what it
does, and a name with no binding here does nothing at all. Hermes cannot
add one. Delete these lines if you do not want Hermes touching the laptop.
Run with --dry-run first. Always.
